mapper.select: SELECT p.name AS patient_name,d.name AS doctor_name,d.title AS doctor_title, dep.name AS department_name,room.name AS clinic_room_name, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AS captured_at FROM med_slot sl JOIN med_schedule s ON s.id=sl.schedule_id JOIN med_doctor d ON d.id=s.doctor_id JOIN med_department dep ON dep.id=d.department_id JOIN med_clinic_room room ON room.id=s.clinic_room_id JOIN med_patient p ON p.id=#{patientId} AND p.owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} WHERE sl.id=#{slotId}
mapper.update: UPDATE med_appointment SET source_encounter_id=#{sourceEncounterId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, booking_patient_name=#{snapshot.patientName}, booking_doctor_name=#{snapshot.doctorName}, booking_doctor_title=#{snapshot.doctorTitle,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, booking_department_name=#{snapshot.departmentName}, booking_clinic_room_name=#{snapshot.clinicRoomName}, booking_snapshot_at=#{snapshot.capturedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE id=#{appointmentId} AND booking_snapshot_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS encounter_id,a.id AS appointment_id,a.patient_id, COALESCE(a.booking_patient_name,p.name) AS patient_name, d.id AS doctor_id,COALESCE(a.booking_doctor_name,d.name) AS doctor_name, dep.id AS department_id,COALESCE(a.booking_department_name,dep.name) AS department_name, sl.work_date,mr.diagnosis FROM med_encounter e JOIN med_appointment a ON a.id=e.appointment_id JOIN med_patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id JOIN med_slot sl ON sl.id=a.slot_id JOIN med_schedule s ON s.id=sl.schedule_id JOIN med_doctor d ON d.id=s.doctor_id JOIN med_department dep ON dep.id=d.department_id LEFT JOIN med_medical_record mr ON mr.encounter_id=e.id WHERE e.id=#{encounterId} AND e.status='COMPLETED' AND p.owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO med_appointment ( patient_id, slot_id, status, confirm_deadline, cancel_deadline ) VALUES ( #{patientId}, #{slotId}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{confirmDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{cancelDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
